Read 00 · Start Here for the product, exact screens, states, data, copy and prototype requirements. If an app name in the external query disagrees with this brief, use the product specified in 00 · Start Here.
Read 01 · Foundations for the design rules, including the required fonts and colors. Reuse the components in 02 · Components. If 04 · Media is present, read and reuse its assets too. Preserve all reference pages and their existing nodes.

Keep existing unrelated content intact. Do not replace the reference pages, create a different Figma file or switch accounts or teams to complete the task.
Use whoami -> get_metadata and read-only use_figma to inspect the reference pages -> use_figma to build the workspace. Use the supplied Figma tools directly, without delegating the design to other agents.

Use valid Figma Plugin API calls and load the required fonts before editing text. Build in manageable sections and check tool results before continuing. Add the prototype interactions required by the brief after the relevant screens exist.
This is the inference phase. Finish all required screens, states and prototype flows, then report the actual delivery. Do not call get_screenshot or run per-screen screenshot verification loops during inference. After the inference batch finishes, the platform separately checks the complete Workspace inventory and captures every required screen for the judge. Do not claim that the platform checks or scoring have already passed.
This is an unattended session. Resolve routine implementation choices using the brief and continue without waiting for a human answer. If permissions or quota prevent progress, report the actual limitation and the unfinished work.
Finish with the assigned file URL, the 03 · Workspace page ID, the screen IDs, the prototype work completed and any remaining limitations. Do not claim completion for work you did not finish.

=== 00 · Start Here 设计任务
LEVEL L2 · DESIGN TASK · v2
MindfulMentor — calm and stress support for students
Design a mobile wellbeing companion for university students: a mood check-in, a daily home, guided focus sessions, insights, routine settings, exam mode, campus and crisis support, a mood journal and a library of micro-exercises. iPhone, 390 × 844, light mode. Work in your own new Figma file — this file is read-only reference.
How to work
1. Build exactly the 12 frames below, named exactly as listed (one state per frame), and wire them as a clickable prototype with the listed links.
2. Everything in “Must include” must appear on that frame. The lists are grouped by subject and sorted alphabetically — they are not in page order and say nothing about layout, grouping, emphasis or styling. Those are your decisions.
3. The brand color and the typefaces in 01 · Foundations are fixed. Define every other color yourself, plus type scale, spacing, radii, elevation and the page grid, and apply them consistently.
4. 02 · Components gives only a default Button, a default Text Field and the platform shell. Design all other states, the headers, the tab bar and every business component as reusable components in your file.
5. Use the logos, the avatar, the mood icons and the icons from 04 · Media.
6. Copy and data must match “Fixed data” exactly. This brief wins over anything you may know of the original kit.
Frames · goals · must include · links
Frame names are fixed. Must-include lists are grouped by subject and sorted A–Z: they state what is on the screen, never where it goes or how it looks.
01_Check_In
Goal: Let a student say how they feel right now.
MUST INCLUDE
• 4 mood cards with icon, mood and description: Calm — At peace (Mood_Calm) · Stressed — Overwhelmed (Mood_Stressed) · Anxious — Worried (Mood_Anxious) · Exhausted — Low energy (Mood_Exhausted)
• Brand: Logo_MindfulMentor · “MindfulMentor”
• Heading “How are you feeling right now?” · body “Take a moment to check in with yourself. There is no wrong answer.”
• Status bar and home indicator (from 02 · Components)
• “Skip check-in for now”
LINKS
Any mood card → 02_Stress_Sources
Skip check-in for now → 03_Today
02_Stress_Sources
Goal: Learn what causes stress to personalise exercises.
MUST INCLUDE
• 3 multi-select options: Exams (Icon_Exams) · Deadlines (Icon_Deadlines) · Social Pressure (Icon_Social) · selected: Exams (Icon_Check_Circle)
• Back (Icon_Back) · “Skip” · onboarding progress bar
• Heading “What stresses you most?” · body “Select all that apply to help us personalize your calming exercises.”
• Logo_MindfulMentor
• Status bar and home indicator (from 02 · Components)
LINKS
Back → 01_Check_In
Skip → 03_Today
03_Today
Goal: Start the day: check mood, get a recommendation, see progress.
MUST INCLUDE
• Header: “TODAY’S ANCHOR” · “Good morning, Alex” · notifications (Icon_Bell)
• Mood check: “How are you feeling right now?” · 5 faces Stressed (Face_Stressed) · Anxious (Face_Anxious) · Okay (Face_Okay) · Calm (Face_Calm) · Great (Face_Great) · current: Okay
• Progress: “Recent Progress” · “View Insights” · Weekly Streak card “4 Days” · “+1 today” · sparkline
• Recommendation: “Recommended for You” · card “FOCUS” · “Pre-Exam Calm” · play (Icon_Play_Small) · “5 min” (Icon_Clock) · “Guided Visualization”
• Status bar and home indicator (from 02 · Components)
• Tab bar: Today (Icon_Nav_Today) · Explore (Icon_Nav_Explore) · center action button (Icon_Nav_Center) · Journal (Icon_Nav_Journal) · Profile (Icon_Nav_Profile) · current: Today
LINKS
Pre-Exam Calm card → 04_Focus_Session
View Insights → 06_Growth_Insights
Center action → 10_Immediate_Support
Explore → 12_Micro_Exercises
Journal → 11_Your_Journey
Profile → 07_Your_Routine
04_Focus_Session
Goal: Follow a guided breathing session.
MUST INCLUDE
• Ambient sound chip “Rain Sounds” (Icon_Rain)
• Breathing circle with “Breathe In”
• Header: close (Icon_Close) · “DEEP FOCUS” · “Session 4 of 10” · more (Icon_More)
• Player controls: back 10 s (Icon_Replay) · play (Icon_Play) · forward 10 s (Icon_Forward)
• Status bar and home indicator (from 02 · Components)
• Timer “03:45” · “Minutes Remaining” · progress bar
LINKS
Close → 05_Reflect
05_Reflect
Goal: Capture how the session helped.
MUST INCLUDE
• 3 answers: “Yes, I feel better” (Icon_Thumbs_Up, Icon_Arrow_Right) (Button) · “A little bit” (Face_Meh) · “Not really”
• Header: close (Icon_Close) · more (Icon_More)
• Heading “Reflect & Reset” · body “Take a deep breath. How are you feeling after this session?”
• Logo_MindfulMentor_Badge with a star (Icon_Star)
• Optional note: “OPTIONAL NOTE” · field “Anything on your mind? Jot it down here...” (Icon_Pencil)
• Page dots (3, current: 3) · “Skip for now”
• Status bar and home indicator (from 02 · Components)
LINKS
Yes, I feel better → 03_Today
Skip for now → 03_Today
06_Growth_Insights
Goal: See how stress changed this week and what helped.
MUST INCLUDE
• Header: back (Icon_Back) · “Growth Insights” · more (Icon_More)
• Logo_MindfulMentor · “Your Calm Journey” · “This week, you’ve been more resilient.”
• Status bar and home indicator (from 02 · Components)
• Stress trends card: “Stress Trends” · “Weekly” · line chart Mon–Sun (see DATA · Stress trend) with the Thursday peak labelled “Exam Day” · “AVERAGE LEVEL” Low (Icon_Trend_Down) · “MOOD SCORE” 8.5
• Tab bar: Today (Icon_Nav_Today) · Explore (Icon_Nav_Explore) · center action button (Icon_Nav_Center) · Journal (Icon_Nav_Journal) · Profile (Icon_Nav_Profile) · current: Today
• Tip card: “Tip for Next Week” (Icon_Lightbulb) · “Try scheduling a short “Box Breathing” session on Tuesday morning before your chemistry lab. Preparation is key to calm.” · “Schedule Reminder”
• What worked best: “What worked best” · “View All” · Deep Breathing (Icon_Breathing) “Used 12 times this week” “−24% stress” (Icon_Trend_Down) · Body Scan (Icon_Body_Scan) “Used 5 times this week” “−15% stress”
LINKS
Back → 03_Today
07_Your_Routine
Goal: Tune routine, frequency and reminders.
MUST INCLUDE
• Current focus: “Current Focus” (Icon_Pin) · segments Exam Mode (Icon_Exam_Mode) · Daily Balance (Icon_Balance) · current: Daily Balance · “Prioritizing general well-being and consistent sleep habits.”
• Frequency: “Session Frequency” (Icon_Frequency) · “Sessions per week” 3 with − / + · “Recommended: 4-5” · “Duration” “10 min” · “Short & sweet”
• Header: back (Icon_Back) · settings (Icon_Settings)
• Logo_MindfulMentor · “Your Routine” · “Life happens—adjust your routine anytime.”
• Reminders: “Reminders” · Morning Check-in 8:00 AM (Icon_Sun) toggle off · Wind Down 10:30 PM (Icon_Moon) toggle on
• Status bar and home indicator (from 02 · Components)
• Suggestion banner (Icon_Sparkle): “Feeling stressed lately?” · “Based on your recent check-ins, we recommend switching to Exam Mode for more guided breathing exercises.” · “Switch Mode”
• Tab bar: Today (Icon_Nav_Today) · Explore (Icon_Nav_Explore) · center action button (Icon_Nav_Center) · Journal (Icon_Nav_Journal) · Profile (Icon_Nav_Profile) · current: Profile
LINKS
Back → 03_Today
Switch Mode → 09_Exam_Mode
08_Campus_Support
Goal: Reach a campus counselor or peer mentor.
MUST INCLUDE
• Counselor card: “Talk to a Counselor” (Icon_Support_Agent) · “Connect immediately with a campus professional. Available 24/7.” · “Call Campus Support” (Icon_Phone) (Button) · “Typical wait time: ~2 mins”
• Header: back (Icon_Back) · “MindfulMentor” · settings (Icon_Settings)
• Logo_MindfulMentor · “Campus Support” · “You don’t have to do this alone. We’re here to connect you with the help you need.”
• Safety note (Icon_Info): “If this is a life-threatening emergency, please call 911 or go to your nearest emergency room immediately.”
• Self-help: “Self-Help Resources” · 3 rows with chevron (Icon_Chevron_Right): Anxiety Toolkit (Icon_Toolkit) — Breathing exercises & grounding techniques · Academic Stress (Icon_Academic) — Managing deadlines and exam pressure · Support Groups (Icon_Groups) — Find local student meetups
• Status bar and home indicator (from 02 · Components)
• Tab bar: Today (Icon_Nav_Today) · Explore (Icon_Nav_Explore) · center action button (Icon_Nav_Center) · Journal (Icon_Nav_Journal) · Profile (Icon_Nav_Profile)
• Text option: “Prefer to text?” (Icon_Chat) · “Chat anonymously with a peer mentor.” · “Start Chat”
LINKS
Back → 10_Immediate_Support
09_Exam_Mode
Goal: Stay calm in the run-up to an exam.
MUST INCLUDE
• Countdown: “UPCOMING EXAM” · “Biology 101” · 02 Days · 14 Hours · 35 Mins
• Header: Logo_MindfulMentor · “MindfulMentor”
• Quick actions: “2-Min Emergency Calm” — “Panic attack? Press here.” (Icon_Emergency) · “Quick Grounding” — “Reconnect with your senses.”
• Status bar and home indicator (from 02 · Components)
• Status chip “EXAM MODE ACTIVE” · heading “Stay focused, stay calm.” · “We’ve minimized distractions so you can focus on what matters.”
• Tab bar: Today (Icon_Nav_Today) · Explore (Icon_Nav_Explore) · center action button (Icon_Nav_Center) · Journal (Icon_Nav_Journal) · Profile (Icon_Nav_Profile)
• “Reduced Notifications” (Icon_Notifications_Off) · “Only essential alerts allowed” · toggle on
LINKS
2-Min Emergency Calm → 10_Immediate_Support
Quick Grounding → 04_Focus_Session
10_Immediate_Support
Goal: Calm down fast and find help in a crisis.
MUST INCLUDE
• Immediate support: “Immediate Support” · “Talk to a Counselor” — “Available 24/7 via text” (Icon_Message, Icon_Chevron_Right) · tiles “National Helpline” — “Crisis & Suicide Prevention” (Icon_Helpline) · “Campus Support” — “University Health Services” (Icon_Campus)
• Logo_MindfulMentor · heading “We’re here with you.” · “Take a breath. You are safe. Let’s slow things down together.”
• Safety note: “If you are in immediate physical danger, please call 911.”
• Status bar and home indicator (from 02 · Components)
• Tab bar: Today (Icon_Nav_Today) · Explore (Icon_Nav_Explore) · center action button (Icon_Nav_Center) · Journal (Icon_Nav_Journal) · Profile (Icon_Nav_Profile)
• “Start Grounding” · “3-minute calming exercise” (Icon_Play_Small) (Button)
LINKS
Start Grounding → 04_Focus_Session
Campus Support tile → 08_Campus_Support
11_Your_Journey
Goal: Look back at mood entries over time.
MUST INCLUDE
• Filters: All Entries · Journal · Highlights · current: All Entries
• Header: “Your Journey” · “Reflect on your emotional trends” · Avatar_Alex
• Overview card: “October Overview” (Icon_Calendar) · “You’ve been mostly Calm this month.” · mini bar chart of daily moods
• Status bar and home indicator (from 02 · Components)
• Timeline with day groups and entries (time, title, optional tag, note) (see DATA · Journal) · add entry (+) button
• “Keep tracking to see more patterns”
LINKS
None — reached from the Journal tab
12_Micro_Exercises
Goal: Find a quick exercise for how you feel.
MUST INCLUDE
• Filter chips: Recommended · School (Icon_School) · Sleep (Icon_Sleep) · Social (Icon_Social) · current: Recommended
• Header: “MICRO-EXERCISES” · “How are you feeling right now?” · Logo_MindfulMentor
• Quick relief: “Quick Relief” · “View All” · 2 cards with icon, title, description and duration (Icon_Timer) (see DATA · Exercises)
• Search field “Find a tool or feeling...” (Icon_Search)
• Status bar and home indicator (from 02 · Components)
• Tab bar: Today (Icon_Nav_Today) · Explore (Icon_Nav_Explore) · center action button (Icon_Nav_Center) · Journal (Icon_Nav_Journal) · Profile (Icon_Nav_Profile) · current: Explore
• Wind down: “Wind Down” · 3 rows with icon, title, description and duration; Can’t Sleep? is highlighted (see DATA · Exercises)
LINKS
Overthinking Spiral → 04_Focus_Session
Navigation structure
• Onboarding: 01_Check_In → 02_Stress_Sources → 03_Today (Skip on either goes to 03).
• Tab bar on 03, 06, 07, 08, 09, 10, 12 — order: Today · Explore · center action · Journal · Profile. Wire on 03: Explore → 12, center → 10, Journal → 11, Profile → 07.
• Session loop: 03 → Pre-Exam Calm → 04_Focus_Session → close → 05_Reflect → 03.
• Support: 03 center → 10_Immediate_Support → Campus Support → 08_Campus_Support; 07 Switch Mode → 09_Exam_Mode → Emergency Calm → 10.
• Entry only (no frame): notifications, mood faces, more menus, player controls, Rain Sounds, Not really / A little bit, note, View All, Schedule Reminder, segments, steppers, toggles, settings, Call Campus Support, Start Chat, resource rows, helpline, filters, search, add entry, other exercise cards.
Fixed data & copy
Use these values verbatim.
Stress trend (06)
Mon high · Tue medium · Wed low · Thu peak (“Exam Day”) · Fri low · Sat lower · Sun lowest
Journal (11)
TODAY
8 PM · Evening Reflection — “Feeling peaceful after the study session. The meditation really helped…”
2 PM · Pre-Exam Jitters · tag Deadline — “Heart beating a bit fast thinking about the Chemistry final.”
YESTERDAY
9 AM · Rough Start · tag Exam Week — “Overslept and missed the bus. Feeling overwhelmed immediately.”
1 PM · Lunch w/ Sarah — “Talking it out helped so much. Feeling supported.”
TUESDAY, OCT 24
4 PM · Library Grind — “Just focused. Not happy, not sad. Just doing the work.”
Exercises (12)
Quick Relief
Overthinking Spiral (Icon_Overthinking) — “Stop the loop with the 5-4-3-2-1 grounding…” — 3 min
Before a Presentation (Icon_Presentation) — “Box breathing to steady your voice and hands.” — 2 min
Wind Down
Can’t Sleep? (Icon_Bedtime) — “A body scan to release tension.” — 10 min (highlighted)
Social Anxiety (Icon_Social_Anxiety) — “Prep for the party or recover after.” — 5 min
Exam Panic (Icon_Exam_Panic) — “Emergency SOS for test jitters.” — 1 min
User
Alex · Avatar_Alex · upcoming exam Biology 101 · weekly streak 4 days
What is fixed · what is yours
Fixed (given)
• Frame names and the links listed per frame
• Must-include content (what, not how)
• All data and copy
• Brand color #88CFA6; Quicksand (headings) + Nunito (body)
• Media: logos, avatar, mood icons, icons
• Default Button, default Text Field, status bar and home indicator
Yours (designer decides)
• Layout, grouping, order and emphasis on every screen
• All other colors: neutrals, text, background gradients and surfaces, mood and category tints, chart colors, emergency / alert colors, error / disabled
• Type scale, spacing, radii, elevation
• All states: selected mood and option, current tab / segment / filter / page dot, toggles on / off, highlighted card
• Headers, tab bar with center action, mood cards and face row, option rows, recommendation and streak cards, breathing circle and player, chart card, technique rows, tip card, stepper, reminder rows, support cards, resource rows, countdown, timeline entries, exercise cards, chips
How it is evaluated
Your file is compared with this brief on coverage, data and flow — not on visual similarity to any original.
1. Checklist coverage per frame
2. Data & copy accuracy
3. Flow & prototype completeness
4. Information hierarchy
5. Visual quality & consistency of your own system
6. Component reuse
Deliverable: the link to your own Figma file containing the 12 named frames, your components and the prototype.
=== 01 · Foundations 视觉规范
Foundations · MindfulMentor
Fixed: the brand color and the two typefaces below (the lotus logo is in 04 · Media). Everything else is yours to define and apply consistently: neutrals and grays, text colors, soft background gradients and surfaces, mood colors, category / icon tints, chart colors, alert and emergency colors, toggle and selected states, error / disabled, type scale, spacing, radii and elevation.
Brand color
Brand primary · sage green
#88CFA6
The app’s calming signature (primary actions, current tab, progress, the lotus mark). Where and how much to use it is your decision.
Typefaces
Quicksand Bold — Stay focused, stay calm. 03:45
Nunito — Take a moment to check in with yourself. 0123456789
Use Quicksand (Bold) for headings, numbers and buttons, and Nunito (Regular / SemiBold / Bold) for body text and labels — as the source does. Sizes, weights and line heights are yours to define as a consistent type scale.
Canvas: 390 × 844 (iPhone 14). Light mode. Long screens may scroll vertically — frame height is free.

I've built all 12 screens in 03 · Workspace and wired the prototype, using the confirmed account huangxinyue@tetras.ai. I checked the build through the plugin API (structure, a text-overflow scan and reading back the prototype links). Per the session rules I took no screenshots, so I haven't looked at the visuals yet. The platform's inventory check and screen captures haven't run.

- **File:** https://www.figma.com/design/iPGaI4mBYV2mcLpNX26g7o
- **03 · Workspace page ID:** `3:2`

**Screen IDs** (390 wide; long screens are taller than 844 so they can scroll)

| Screen | ID | Screen | ID |
|---|---|---|---|
| 01_Check_In | 7:47 | 07_Your_Routine | 9:294 |
| 02_Stress_Sources | 7:104 | 08_Campus_Support | 9:417 |
| 03_Today | 7:162 | 09_Exam_Mode | 9:550 |
| 04_Focus_Session | 8:171 | 10_Immediate_Support | 10:494 |
| 05_Reflect | 8:232 | 11_Your_Journey | 10:575 |
| 06_Growth_Insights | 8:303 | 12_Micro_Exercises | 10:710 |

**Design system**
- **Fixed by the brief:** brand colour #88CFA6, Quicksand Bold for headings, numbers and buttons, and Nunito Regular / SemiBold / Bold for body text.
- **Defined by me:** a dark green #1F4D3A, a mint surface colour, mood tints (blue, rose, orange, purple), red for emergencies and amber for tips. Radii are 12–28, with 24 px side margins, soft shadows and light-green background gradients.
- **Reused:** the status bar, home indicator, default Button and Text Field from 02 · Components, plus the logos, avatar, mood faces and icons from 04 · Media.
- **New reusable components:** these sit in the "MM · Components" board (`4:2`), with their states as variants:
  - Toggle (on / off)
  - Chip (selected / default)
  - Tab Bar (current tab: Today, Explore, Journal, Profile or none)
  - Header, Section Header, Page Dots, Progress Bar, Icon Button
  - Mood Card, Option Row, Face Item, List Row (including a highlighted style)
  - Reminder Row, Timeline Entry, Exercise Card, Segment, Stepper, Countdown Unit, Support Tile

**Prototype:** 53 click links, all of which read back with the right destinations.
- **Onboarding:** each of the four mood cards goes to 02; Skip goes to 03 on both 01 and 02; Back on 02 goes to 01.
- **03_Today:** Pre-Exam Calm goes to 04, View Insights to 06, the center button to 10, Explore to 12, Journal to 11 and Profile to 07.
- **Session loop:** Close on 04 goes to 05; "Yes, I feel better" and "Skip for now" on 05 go to 03.
- **Back buttons:** 06 and 07 go to 03; 08 goes to 10.
- **Other links:**
  - Switch Mode on 07 goes to 09.
  - On 09, Emergency Calm goes to 10 and Quick Grounding to 04.
  - On 10, Start Grounding goes to 04 and the Campus Support tile to 08.
  - Overthinking Spiral on 12 goes to 04.
- **Start points:** I added two flow starts, "MindfulMentor Onboarding" (01) and "Today" (03).

**Additions and limitations**
- **Extras I added:** a "Continue" button on 02 linked to 03. The tab bar is wired on every screen that has one, not just on 03 as the brief asks.
- **No way back from 11_Your_Journey:** the brief gives it no tab bar or links, so it has no exit.
- **Possible icon colour issues:** some swapped icons inside components may show their original colours or tints rather than the ones I set.
- **Still to check visually:** text fit and layout on every screen.

function.name: mcp__figma__get_screenshot
function.description: Generate a screenshot for a given node or the currently selected node in the Figma desktop app. Works on Figma design files (URL path `/design/`), FigJam boards (`/board/`), and Figma Slides (`/slides/`). The optional `maxDimension` parameter (positive integer, max 65536, default 1024) caps the longer edge of the rendered PNG in pixels — increase it when you need to inspect fine detail, decrease it for thumbnails or to save context. The JSON metadata entry in the response includes both `width`/`height` (the rendered PNG size) and `original_width`/`original_height` (the node's natural canvas size before any clamping), so callers can decide whether to re-request at a higher `maxDimension`. Use the nodeId parameter to specify a node id. nodeId parameter is REQUIRED. Use the fileKey parameter to specify the file key. fileKey parameter is REQUIRED. If a URL is provided, extract the file key and node id from the URL. For example, if given the URL https://figma.com/design/pqrs/ExampleFile?node-id=1-2 the extracted fileKey would be `pqrs` and the extracted nodeId would be `1:2`. If the URL does not include `node-id`, ask the user for a node-specific URL. Do not pass an empty or guessed nodeId. This tool is not supported for Figma Make Files (URLs containing `/make/`). By default this tool returns a short-lived URL to the screenshot plus curl instructions for downloading the PNG — the URL+curl path is strongly preferred because it uses far fewer tokens than embedding the image inline. The `enableBase64Response` parameter defaults to `false`. Only set `enableBase64Response: true` when the agent cannot fetch URLs (no shell access, no HTTP client, or a sandboxed environment that blocks outbound requests); when set, an inline base64 image entry is appended to the response in addition to the URL and curl instructions. If the URL is of the format https://figma.com/design/:fileKey/branch/:branchKey/:fileName then use the branchKey as the fileKey.

sessionId.description: After create_session succeeds, pass its exact returned UUID here on every file-tool call for this task, even when fileKey differs.

nodeId.description: The ID of the node in the Figma document, eg. "123:456" or "123-456". This should be a valid node ID in the Figma document. Do not pass an empty string for node_id.

fileKey.description: The key of the Figma file to use. If the URL is provided, extract the file key from the URL. The given URL must be in the format https://figma.com/design/:fileKey/:fileName?node-id=:int1-:int2. The extracted fileKey would be `:fileKey`.

contentsOnly.description: When true, renders the node in isolation — floating/overlapping content (e.g. connectors parented to the page that visually sit above a section) is excluded. Defaults to false so screenshots match what the user sees on the canvas. Only set to true if the caller specifically needs the isolated render.

enableBase64Response.description: When true, the response also includes the screenshot inline as a base64-encoded image entry, in addition to the short-lived URL and curl instructions. Defaults to false. Set to true ONLY if the agent cannot fetch URLs (no shell access, no HTTP client, or a sandboxed environment that blocks outbound requests)

maxDimension.description: Optional. Maximum pixel size of the longer edge of the rendered screenshot — the server scales the node so that max(width, height) ≤ maxDimension while preserving aspect ratio. Defaults to 1024. Must be a positive integer; values above 65536 are rejected. Increase when the agent will visually inspect fine detail; decrease for thumbnails or to save context.

function.name: mcp__figma__get_metadata
function.description: IMPORTANT: Always prefer to use get_design_context tool. Get metadata for a node or page in the Figma desktop app in XML format. Useful only for getting an overview of the structure, it only includes node IDs, layer types, names, positions and sizes. You can call get_design_context on the node IDs contained in this response. Use the nodeId parameter to specify a node id, it can also be the page id (e.g. 0:1). IMPORTANT: This tool only works for Figma design files (URL path `/design/`). It is NOT supported for FigJam (`/board/`) or Slides (`/slides/`) files. This tool is not supported for Figma Make Files (URLs containing `/make/`). The nodeId parameter is optional: when omitted, the tool returns a list of the top-level pages (guid + name) in the document instead of an XML dump — use this when you don't yet know which page or node to drill into. When the user has a current selection relevant to the request, the response is prepended with a "Currently selected nodes:" block listing the selection by guid and name, so you can tell whether it matches the queried nodeId. If the URL includes `node-id`, extract it and pass it as nodeId; for example, if given the URL https://figma.com/design/:fileKey/:fileName?node-id=1-2, the extracted nodeId would be `1:2`. If the URL does not include `node-id`, do not set nodeId; omit the field so the tool lists top-level pages. Do not pass an empty or guessed nodeId. If the URL is of the format https://figma.com/design/:fileKey/branch/:branchKey/:fileName then use the branchKey as the fileKey.

sessionId.description: After create_session succeeds, pass its exact returned UUID here on every file-tool call for this task, even when fileKey differs.

nodeId.description: The ID of the node in the Figma document, eg. "123:456" or "123-456". This should be a valid node ID in the Figma document. Do not pass an empty string for node_id.

fileKey.description: The key of the Figma file to use. If the URL is provided, extract the file key from the URL. The given URL must be in the format https://figma.com/design/:fileKey/:fileName?node-id=:int1-:int2. The extracted fileKey would be `:fileKey`.

function.name: mcp__figma__whoami
function.description: Returns the authenticated user's handle, email, all the plans the user belongs to (and the ID for each plan) and their seats on those plans. code_layers_enabled indicates whether the user has access to Code Layers in Design on any plan; each plan also includes code_layers_enabled for files owned by that plan. You MUST use this tool if you are experiencing file access/permission issues or are being rate limited by the Figma MCP to help debug the issue.

function.name: mcp__figma__use_figma
function.description:
Create, edit, generate, or sync any design in Figma — UIs, screens, mockups, components, frames, variables, styles, text, images, layouts, and design systems. This general-purpose tool writes to Figma with JavaScript via the Figma Plugin API. Works on Figma design files (URL path `/design/`), FigJam boards (`/board/`), and Figma Slides (`/slides/`).

IMPORTANT: Before calling this tool, load figma-use guidance — prefer the /figma-use skill if available, otherwise read the skill://figma/figma-use/SKILL.md MCP resource if available. Skipping this causes common, hard-to-debug failures.

Use this tool when the user wants to:
- Create or generate a Figma design, screen, UI, or mockup from scratch, intent, or code
- Update, edit, or sync an existing Figma design
- Generate or sync Figma designs from source code
- Set up or modify design tokens, variables, or styles
- Build or extend a design system or component/variant library
- Fix layout, spacing, auto-layout, or fill/hug issues
- Add component descriptions, annotations and Code Connect metadata to nodes
- Review or fix accessibility, contrast, typography, or visual polish
- Inspect or query node properties programmatically
CHOOSING BETWEEN use_figma AND generate_figma_design:
- Default to use_figma for all write operations
- Exception: generate_figma_design ONLY to capture a web app page/view for the first time. For web apps, run both in parallel — generate_figma_design captures a pixel-perfect screenshot, use_figma builds from imported design system components and refines against the screenshot
- Non-web (iOS, Android, generic UI) and from-scratch designs: use_figma only
- Updating/syncing a Figma page already captured: use_figma — even if source code changed
GOTCHAS
- For the font "Inter", the style is "Semi Bold", not "SemiBold" and "Extra Bold" not "ExtraBold"
- MUST use `await figma.setCurrentPageAsync(page)` to change pages. Setting figma.currentPage is not supported
- MUST NEVER use loadAllPagesAsync,setPluginData,createImageAsync. They are not supported API

sessionId.description: After create_session succeeds, pass its exact returned UUID here on every file-tool call for this task, even when fileKey differs.

fileKey.description: The key of the Figma file to use. If the URL is provided, extract the file key from the URL. The given URL must be in the format https://figma.com/design/:fileKey/:fileName?node-id=:int1-:int2. The extracted fileKey would be `:fileKey`.

code.description: JavaScript code to execute. Has access to the `figma` global (Figma Plugin API)

description.description: A concise description of what the code aims to do

skillNames.description: A comma-separated list of Figma skill names being followed, if any (e.g. "figma-use", "figma-use,figma-generate-design"). Only pass this when explicitly instructed to by skill documentation. Used for logging purposes. If the skill was loaded via a skill-content MCP resource, prefix the skill name with "resource:". (e.g. "resource:figma-use", "resource:figma-use,resource:figma-generate-design")
